Question: A 38-year-old woman, gravida 3, para 2, at 12 weeks' gestation comes to her obstetrician for a prenatal visit. Screening tests in the first trimester showed a decreased level of pregnancy-associated plasma protein and an increased level of β-hCG. A genetic disorder is suspected. Which of the following results from an additional diagnostic test is most likely to confirm the diagnosis?

Options:
opa. Increased nuchal translucency on ultrasound
opb. Additional chromosome in placental tissue
opc. Decreased estriol in maternal serum
opd. Triploidy in amniotic fluid
ope. Decreased inhibin A in maternal serum
